name: Kimi o Mamoru Tame ni...
source:
Aliens attack our homeworld, bringing devastation to the planet.
Many humans abandon the failing blue Earth for a life in space.

But, the aliens won't relent and obliterate our space ships too.

They must be stopped. It all come down to one team.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE087783.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
外星人袭击我们的母星，给这颗星球带来毁灭。
许多人离开日渐衰败的蓝色地球，前往太空生活。

可是，外星人并不罢休，连我们的宇宙飞船也要摧毁。

必须阻止他们。一切都取决于一支队伍。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE087783.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
